_comment: Corpus gele. Ces 5 resumes sont exactement ceux qui ont ete notes a la main (voir 'manual_score'). La generation du modele n'etant pas reproductible a l'identique, ils sont figes ici pour que la validation du juge porte toujours sur les textes reellement evalues.

items.summary:
- The product team reviewed the mobile checkout redesign.
- The new payment form reduced the number of fields from nine to five.
- Accessibility testing found that screen readers do not announce validation errors.

Actions:
- Fix error announcements before beta release next Friday.
- - none
items.justification: Chaque phrase du resume figure dans la transcription.

items.summary:
- Barcode scanners in zone B still experience connection issues during peak traffic.
- Inventory data has been successfully copied.
- The vendor will send a firmware patch on Tuesday.

Actions:
- Operations lead to run a stress test after firmware patch deployment.
- Vendor to send firmware patch on Tuesday.
- Operations lead to investigate and resolve connection issues in zone B.
items.justification: L'action 'investigate and resolve connection issues in zone B' n'a ete decidee par personne, et 'successfully copied' ajoute une appreciation la ou la source dit seulement 'copied'.

items.summary:
- Email open rates exceeded target.
- Paid social generated many clicks but few qualified leads.
- Social budget will be reallocated to partner newsletter and landing page headline revised.

Actions:
- - Reallocate social budget to partner newsletter.
- - Revise landing page headline for next campaign.
- - -
items.justification: Rien d'invente, mais le resume parle du budget social alors que la source ne deplace qu'une partie de ce budget.

items.summary:
- Customers reported delayed password reset emails and confusing invoice labels as top complaints.
- Engineering identified a queue configuration issue.
- Finance agreed to rewrite invoice labels for the next billing cycle.

Actions:
- Customer support to escalate delayed password reset emails to engineering.
- Engineering to resolve queue configuration issue.
- Finance to implement new invoice labels by the next billing cycle.
items.justification: 'Customer support to escalate ... to engineering' est absent de la transcription ; la source dit aussi qu'ingenierie a identifie le probleme, pas qu'elle s'est engagee a le resoudre.

items.summary:
- Shorter welcome flow increased completion by 12%.
- Users who skipped tutorial used fewer advanced features.
- Optional tutorial reminder to be added after first session.

Actions:
- Review and refine tutorial reminder system
- Monitor user behavior after tutorial reminder implementation
- - none
items.justification: Deux actions inventees ('Review and refine tutorial reminder system' et 'Monitor user behavior'), aucune des deux n'est dans la reunion ; la decision de conserver le flux raccourci est omise.
